2317-6763-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

1981-2415-6273-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4871-5231-8168.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token with flying due to Draconic Visitor.
Repeat.

3129-5231-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.

147-997-1854.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-997-1854.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3220-3249-6006--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3220-3249-6006--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Golgari Germination triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

4186-6830-6996-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-6830-6996-7810.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

624-670-1619-4284.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
624-670-1619-4284.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Phantasmal Image and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
624-670-1619-4284.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

862-1591-3652-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
862-1591-3652-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

670-1619-1734-6147.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-1734-6147.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Rilsa Rael.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, it triggers, returning Rilsa Rael from exile to the battlefield.
When Rilsa Rael enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Rilsa Rael trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Rilsa Rael.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7296-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7296-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-7296-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1824-2530-2932-4668.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-2932-4668.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least 1 card this turn.
1824-2530-2932-4668.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

773-1409-4772.description:
Activate Galazeth Prismari by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Galazeth Prismari enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Galazeth Prismari.
Resolve the Galazeth Prismari trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

4002-4331-4993-6595.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
4002-4331-4993-6595.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0} due to Lyse Hext.
Lyse Hext's prowess ability triggers, giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Manifold Key enters.
Repeat.

11-121-2575-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-121-2575-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Temporal Mastery by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Temporal Mastery.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Temporal Mastery spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Temporal Mastery spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Temporal Mastery and returning the original Temporal Mastery to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Temporal Mastery from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

uses.exileCardState: was foretold on a previous turn

3750-6999-7019.easyPrerequisites: You and an opponent each control a creature.
3750-6999-7019.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
3750-6999-7019.description:
Cast The Last Agni Kai by paying {1}{R}.
Cast Sozin's Comet either from your hand by paying {3}{R}{R} or from exile for its foretell cost by paying {2}{R}.
Declare a creature as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to The Last Agni Kai.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3.
3750-6999-7019.notes: You can attack with multiple creatures to get infinite red mana. Depending on the boardstate, you can use the same creature to fight in step 1 and to attack with. You may also net red mana that can then reduce the overall cost and help pay for Sozin's Comet.

3504-5299-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Mercurial Pretender
3504-5299-5466.description:
Cast Mercurial Pretender by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Mercurial Pretender into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mercurial Pretender's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Mercurial Pretender's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Mercurial Pretender's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

586-3375-5258-5618-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2921-4484-4871-6518.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
2921-4484-4871-6518.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Zombie Druid.
When the Zombie Druid dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

1636-5526-5996.easyPrerequisites: Tarmogoyf Nest does not have summoning sickness.
1636-5526-5996.notablePrerequisites: Creatures and/or lands you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
1636-5526-5996.description:
Activate Kamahl's Will by paying {3}{G}, causing lands you control to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate any number of creatures and/or lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
When the Tarmogoyf enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

2736-3221-3283.description:
Activate Zedruu by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Notion Thief to the next opponent in turn order.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Consecrated Sphinx triggers, causing the opponent to draw two cards due to Notion Thief.
Consecrated Sphinx triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, causing the opponent to draw two cards due to Notion Thief.
Repeat from step 4 until the opponent loses the game due to drawing from an empty library.
When the opponent loses the game, you regain control of Notion Thief.
Activate Zedruu by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Notion Thief to an opponent.
Resolve a Consecrated Sphinx trigger, causing the opponent who controls Notion Thief to draw two cards.
Repeat from step 4.

969-3742-4251-4344-4875.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
"Samurai" chosen with Conspiracy.
969-3742-4251-4344-4875.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Lumbering Battlement.
When the token Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Godo until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
At the end of your combat phase, the token Lumbering Battlement triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
The token Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1636-2857-4753.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one legendary creature.
1636-2857-4753.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting any legendary creature you control.
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying {2}{U}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of the legendary creature targeted in step 1.
Put the legendary creature into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Clever Impersonator.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 4, returning the legendary creature to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Put Clever Impersonator into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting the legendary creature.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 9, returning Clever Impersonator to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of the legendary creature.
Repeat from step 3.

1558-2963-4840-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a 4/4 Mishra's Warform artifact creature token.
At the beginning of your end step, Mishra and Teleportation Circle triggers.
Resolve the Teleportation Circle trigger, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Myrs and Mishra's Warform, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Mishra trigger, failing to sacrifice the Mishra's Warform token due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

65-1094-2051-2546-4298.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
65-1094-2051-2546-4298.description:
Activate Slippery Karst's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Slippery Karst ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Borborygmos ability, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Slippery Karst and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1518-1987-2493.notablePrerequisites:
Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
You control an artifact and/or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
1518-1987-2493.description:
Activate Will's second ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing target player to draw two cards and causing all instant, sorcery and planeswalker spells you cast to cost {2} less this turn.
Activate the aritfact and/or land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking Archaeomancer and the artifact and/or land.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Ghostly Flicker from the graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
